integrityProcedure: Regenerate MANIFEST.sha256 from every distributed source file except the manifest itself.
Create one stable MagnaMath-Rebuilt archive root.
Run Python zipfile.testzip against every member.
Run unzip -t as an independent archive-integrity check.
Write the final archive SHA-256 beside the ZIP to avoid a circular embedded checksum.
status: Expected archive structure and integrity procedure defined; final checksum is intentionally external.
